summary: Fundrise eREIT, LLC filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 disclosing that its Manager declared a daily distribution of $0.0000684930 per share for each day in the October 2026 period, equating to roughly a 0.25% annualized rate based on a $9.87 per-share purchase price. Distributions apply to holders of record each day from October 1 through October 31, 2026, payable before January 21, 2027. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or transaction mechanics are present; this is a routine REIT distribution notice, not a special situation.
